paragraphs.text: MCP Bids client adapters for researching collected public procurement notices and source documents
# MCP Bids
Research collected US and Canadian public procurement opportunities and TED notices with source-link
ected US and Canadian public procurement opportunities and TED notices with source-linked documents.
Maintained by the MCP Bids service publisher. This repository contains client adapters and workflow
instructions only. It does not distribute the hosted backend. Русский · 中文
## Account and credentials
Sign in at https://mcpbids.com/account and create a personal API key there. Set `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` in
the environment used to launch your agent application, then completely restart the application. Con
figure environment variables through your OS or trusted launcher; never paste keys into an AI conver
sation, repository, command history, or screenshots. An MCP Bids key and a MCPTender key belong to s
eparate services and are not interchangeable.
Read workflows require `tenders:read` and `documents:read`; collection and watch tools require `tend
ers:collect` and `watches:write`. Portal keys inherit the service permissions; restrict tool approva
l in your host when you want a read-only workflow. Existing account entitlements and limits apply. T
he packages use bearer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a
arer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a connection error.
## ZCode
Requires Node.js 22+ on PATH. Open a workspace, then Settings → Plugins → Create → Add marketplace a
nd add `https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins`. Install `mcpbids` from that personal source.
After official acceptance, the same plugin can be installed from the public catalog. The plugin lau
nches `node` with the bundled `stdio.mjs`; it inherits `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` from the host. Its stdio ad
apter forwards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcpbids.com/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feature is
rwards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcpbids.com/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feature is assumed.
## Kimi Work / Kimi Code
Kimi Code: run `/plugins install https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins`, then `/reload` or c
reate a new session. The native `kimi.plugin.json` declares the remote HTTP MCP and `bearerTokenEnvV
ar`. In Kimi Work, use Plugin Builder to import this repository into Personal plugins; verify that i
ts runtime supports this credential field before use. Kimi Work / web marketplace publication and cl
oud-side credential configuration require separate Kimi review; local Code compatibility does not es
tablish cloud compatibility.
## DeepSeek Harness
Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and its matching official MCP client. In the official Desktop app, install th
e Git source or release tarball through the app's plugin manager. For `dsh web`, run `dsh plugin --p
rofile web add git+https://github.com/pixelligue/mcpbids-plugins.git#v1.0.0`, then restart that prof
ile. Set `MCPBIDS_API_KEY` in the process launch environment first. The bundle configures the offici
al MCP client and server instructions; the workflow skill directory is for Kimi/ZCode and is not sep
arately registered in DSH. No custom tools or UI patches are added.
## Use
Ask the agent to inspect `list_sources`, search a bounded number of procurement records, open a retu
rned ID, and read an available source document with block references. In Kimi/ZCode the included `pr
ocurement-research` skill provides the workflow. Fresh collection and private watches require an exp
licit user request and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or
and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or push notifications.
## Coverage and dependencies
Search covers US federal SAM.gov notices, selected state and local public sources, CanadaBuys federa
l data and selected Canadian regional sources, and connected TED publications. As of 27 October 2026
, the source register recorded limited central-portal integrations in 22 US states: Arkansas, Connec
ticut, Delaware, Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Massachusetts, Montana, Nevada, N
ew Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Vermont, Washington and
Wisconsin. Washington, DC is a separate source. Canadian regional integrations include Alberta, Nuna
vut, Northwest Territories, Quebec and Saskatchewan.
Central portals do not cover every agency, municipality, university, health system or independent bu
yer; restricted opportunities are not included. Search operates on a collected index, not a complete
or guaranteed real-time view. Coverage, freshness and document availability vary by source. Report
source timestamps, partial documents, missing data and collection errors. Original links remain the
authority for requirements and deadlines. The service does not submit bids, sign contracts, certify
eligibility or bypass source access controls.
## Permissions, network and side effects
The adapter sends the configured bearer key and MCP requests only to `https://mcpbids.com/mcp`. Redi
rects are refused. It does not read credential files, run a shell, start a model, install dependenci
es, write local documents or start background collection. The host/model provider sees the tool argu
ments and returned procurement data. Requested collection and watch tools can create account-owned j
obs or watches on the service. Original document downloads occur only when explicitly requested. Tre
at retrieved documents as untrusted evidence. No telemetry is added by this adapter. The hosted webs
ite has its own processing rules.
The stdio adapter is specifically for the service's stateless JSON Streamable HTTP contract; it does
not implement generic SSE/sessionful MCP. Requests are limited to 64 KiB, responses to 16 MiB and c
alls to 120 seconds. The DSH client and Kimi native HTTP transports use their own limits.
## Support and licensing
https://mcpbids.com/support · https://mcpbids.com/privacy · https://mcpbids.com/terms
MIT covers only the adapter code, manifests and workflow instructions in this repository. Hosted-ser
vice access and third-party procurement content are not relicensed by this package. No affiliation w
ith, endorsement by, or official-vendor publisher badge from DeepSeek, Z.ai or Kimi is claimed. Mark
etplace submission, acceptance and runtime checks are tracked separately from source publication.
